cohort: 40 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 by RT-PCR and their 41 neonates
finding: There was no evidence of vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 from mothers to newborns, and no delivery complications were observed.
mod_finding: Of the 41 neonates, 26 (63.4%) were delivered by cesarean section, while 15 (36.6%) had a vaginal delivery.
